title: Hand of Rodin with a Female Figure

events.t: Hand of Rodin with a Female Figure

events.n: [1] This work could only have been given to Mrs. Simpson after Rodin's death in November 1917, and presumably after the end of World War I in November 1918. The most likely time for Léonce Bénédite, the first director of the Musée Rodin, to have made such a gift was in 1921, when Mrs. Simpson donated funds to restore Rodin's home in Meudon. She had been there in the spring of 1921 and told Bénédite how disturbed she was by its dilapidated state (Musée Rodin curatorial files).
events.q: Gift probably 1921 from the Musée Rodin to Mrs. John W. Simpson, New York
